questions.question: How do I measure my chest accurately before selecting a size?
questions.answer: Wrap a flexible tape measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape parallel to the floor.

questions.question: What is the return window for international orders?
questions.answer: 30 days from delivery date with pre-printed customs return documentation included.

questions.question: What ironing temperature is safe for the outer fabric?
questions.answer: Use low heat steam setting (max 110°C). Always place a damp press cloth between the iron and garment.
